text: Free prompt-budget room before more instructions are added: the change verifier composes at 1298 of its 1300-token budget, the study verifier at 1296 and the study producer at 1276 (cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets -- --nocapture prints them), so most prompt fixes now fail the budgets test. Find text in those prompts and their shared frames that repeats what the briefs already say or that no current rule needs, remove it, and leave each of these sets at least 100 tokens under budget. Acceptance: the budgets test passes and prints the new sizes; no behavior criterion or brief test changes meaning; a docs/decisions.md entry lists what was removed and why.
